name: Blood and Dices
source:
Play as Askarol, a guy who was born on a mountain and is a fighter, in an adventure to fight and train, to defeat his biggest enemy Naloneus, in times of semi-modern Japan.

[From [url=https://futuresoft.itch.io/blood-and-dices]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演Askarol，一名出生在山上的战士，踏上冒险之旅，一边战斗、训练，一边击败宿敌Naloneus。故事发生在半现代的日本。

[来源：[url=https://futuresoft.itch.io/blood-and-dices]Itch.io[/url]]
